In Islamic culture, this name is given to a girl who is deeply committed to Islam and Allah. This name signifies determination, dedication, and loyalty to the faith and creator.

The name serves as a reminder of the ultimate goal of every Muslim - to attain closeness to Allah and achieve eternal happiness in Jannah.
